messages:
maya (PM): quick sync — BigRetail asked for the advanced filtering UI + SOC2 contract clause by EoQ. Sales says it's a must for the closed deal.
rajan (Sales): Yup, they want a deadline in the SOW. They sign faster if we commit to SOC2 within 90 days. can we do a carveout? :thinking_face:
liam (Eng): Feature-wise the filtering UI is ~3 sprint effort. SOC2 full scope is much larger — depends on infra boundary and log retention.
dorte (Security): We can propose a phased audit scope. Core auth/infra + config audit within 90d, then apps/analytics in Q2. That reduces immediate cert effort.
sasha (CSE): Customer will accept phased if we include contractual milestones and interim attestations. They care about data residency + access controls.
maya (PM): proposing RICE quick calc to compare options. roughs:
```
Option A (Ship UI fast + SOC2 delayed): Reach=40, Impact=7, Confidence=60%, Effort=5 -> RICE = (40*7*0.6)/5 = 33.6
Option B (Commit to SOC2 now + slower feature): Reach=25, Impact=9, Confidence=70%, Effort=12 -> RICE = (25*9*0.7)/12 = 13.125
```
maya (PM): numbers suggest higher immediate ROI shipping UI and negotiating scope. but contract/legal risk remains.
dorte (Security): Agree on phased SOC2 but must add compensating controls: tenant-level feature toggle, strict RBAC, encrypted-at-rest proof, and quarterly evidence snapshots.
rajan (Sales): If we offer a price credit tied to SOC2 milestone completion (e.g., 5% refund if not done by X), execs are happy. avoids hard date in SOW.
liam (Eng): Implementation notes: we can gate the UI behind an `enterprise-compliance` flag and enable for BigRetail once controls exist. That buys time for SOC2 work.
sasha (CSE): I'll draft customer-facing wording: phased compliance timeline + guaranteed interim controls + milestone SLA. Good for legal review.
maya (PM): Decision ask for leadership: approve phased SOC2 scope + gated feature deploy + milestone-based commercial protection. also ask for 2 FTEs from infra for 10 weeks to hit first phase.
dorte (Security): If leadership signs off, security will prepare the SOC2 scope doc and the compensating controls list within 3 business days.
audit-bot: new audit ticket created: AUD-4721 - SOC2 phased scope for BigRetail. Link: https://redwood.internal/audits/AUD-4721
rajan (Sales): Great. I'll loop legal and customer. Thanks all :thumbsup:
maya (PM): tagging @executive-team for approval. next steps: legal draft, infra headcount, and sales commercial language.
liam (Eng): noted — I'll sketch the feature toggle plan and estimate infra time by EOD.
maya (PM): thanks — will follow up in product sync.
